basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Nagpur (Nuclear Medicine) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 6 Technologist, Technical Officer & Other Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Nuclear Medicine at All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur is filling 6 posts on contract for 11 months, 2 each of Technologist, Technical Officer and Senior Technical Officer (Nuclear Medicine), at consolidated pay of Rs. 56,640, Rs. 89,760 and Rs. 1,08,320 per month respectively. Eligible Indian nationals must send the prescribed application, the fee receipt and certificate copies through the Google form named in the notice so that it reaches by 5:00 PM on 11 December 2026 (advertisement No. AIIMS/NGP/RECT/CONT/26/13/3406 dated 25/11/2026).

how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application form from the AIIMS Nagpur website (https://aiimsnagpur.edu.in) and fill it in.
Pay the application fee by NEFT to the bank account below if you belong to the General/OBC/EWS category.
Collect self-attested copies of certificates/testimonials and other relevant documents.
Send the application, the copy of the payment receipt and the relevant copies of certificates through the Google form https://forms.gle/PwpoQemoSVpBU3bZ8.
Make sure the submission reaches by 05:00 PM on or before 11 December 2026.
Mention the post applied for in the subject line if you write to the recruitment e-mail for any clarification.

The notice says incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. The notice calls 11 December 2026 the first cut-off date. Vacancies left unfilled after the first selection process will be notified on the Institute's website with later cut-off dates.
The fee is non-refundable. A copy of the receipt must be enclosed with the application, and candidates may bring it when attending the interview. NEFT account details as printed:
Name of the Bank: BANK OF BARODA
Name of Account Holder: AIIMS EXAM FEE
Copy of the fee payment receipt
Self-attested copies of certificates/testimonials and other relevant documents
All relevant original documents, to be produced for verification before the interview
No Objection Certificate from the present employer, for those working in Central/State Government/Semi Government/Autonomous body, at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur
Technologist (Nuclear Medicine); Technical Officer (Nuclear Medicine); Senior Technical Officer (Nuclear Medicine)
Rs. 56,640/-, Rs. 89,760/- and Rs. 1,08,320/- per month (consolidated), post-wise
Prescribed application form with fee receipt and certificates sent by Google form

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 6 vacancies in total, 2 for each post, all in the UR category. The vacancies are provisional and subject to variation; the Executive Director reserves the right to vary them as per requirements and Government of India rules/circulars. The reservation is as per the roster provided by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals may apply. The age limit for all three posts is upto 40 years. Age means completed age in years as on the last date of submission of application, and all prescribed qualifications are counted as on that last date. The prescribed qualifications are minimum; having them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview or selected. The diplomas named for the alternative route are Diploma in Medical Radio-Isotope Techniques (DMRIT), Diploma in Nuclear Medicine Technology (DNMT) and Diploma in Fusion Imaging Technology (DFIT). The notice gives no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: B.Sc in Nuclear Medicine Technology from recognized university/institution; OR B.Sc in life sciences with post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine (DMRIT / DNMT / DFIT)
rows.desirable: Experience in a full-fledged Nuclear Medicine Centre having PET/CT, Gamma camera/SPECT/CT and radionuclide therapy will be preferred

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc Nuclear medicine technology from recognized university/institution; and 5 years of experience as Nuclear Medicine technologist (B.Sc Nuclear Medicine or equivalent + 5 years experience)
rows.desirable: RSO level II certification; experience in a full-fledged Nuclear Medicine Centre as above preferred

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc Nuclear Medicine Technology from recognized university/institution with 60% marks; OR M.Sc with minimum 60% marks with post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine (DMRIT / DNMT / DFIT) with minimum 50% marks; and 02 years' experience
rows.desirable: RSO level II certification; PhD in Nuclear medicine specialty; experience in a full-fledged Nuclear Medicine Centre as above preferred

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is consolidated, with no enhancement during the contract period, and the emoluments are determined by the competent authority. The contract is for 11 (Eleven) Months or till the regular appointments against these vacant posts are made, whichever is earlier, from the date of joining. The notice says the period of contract may be extended as per the requirement of the Institute and subject to satisfactory performance. If the contract is not extended, it lapses automatically. Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 01 day for each completed month of service. No Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion or other benefits of regular Government servants are admissible. No extra or additional allowances for any duty assigned by the competent authority. The appointee is not entitled to allowances or facilities extended to regular/permanent faculty members of AIIMS Nagpur.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form from the AIIMS Nagpur website ( https://aiimsnagpur.edu.in ) and fill it in. Pay the application fee by NEFT to the bank account below if you belong to the General/OBC/EWS category. Collect self-attested copies of certificates/testimonials and other relevant documents. Send the application, the copy of the payment receipt and the relevant copies of certificates through the Google form https://forms.gle/PwpoQemoSVpBU3bZ8 . Make sure the submission reaches by 05:00 PM on or before 11 December 2026. Mention the post applied for in the subject line if you write to the recruitment e-mail for any clarification. The notice says incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. The notice calls 11 December 2026 the first cut-off date. Vacancies left unfilled after the first selection process will be notified on the Institute's website with later cut-off dates. The fee is non-refundable. A copy of the receipt must be enclosed with the application, and candidates may bring it when attending the interview. NEFT account details as printed: Name of the Bank: BANK OF BARODA Branch: AIIMS NAGPUR, CAMPUS Name of Account Holder: AIIMS EXAM FEE Account No: 40680200000276 IFSC: BARB0VJNAAP (5th character is zero) MICR code: 440012015 Application in the prescribed format Copy of the fee payment receipt Self-attested copies of certificates/testimonials and other relevant documents All relevant original documents, to be produced for verification before the interview No Objection Certificate from the present employer, for those working in Central/State Government/Semi Government/Autonomous body, at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice describes shortlisting, scrutiny of documents and an interview. Shortlisting for interview is done on the basis of educational qualification, relevant experience and/or the short-listing criteria decided by the Executive Director, AIIMS Nagpur. If a large number of applications is received, there may be a screening test to shortlist candidates for interviews. Before the interview, a duly constituted committee scrutinises applications and verifies documents on qualification, experience, category and age. Only candidates declared eligible may appear for interview. The interview will be held at AIIMS Nagpur or at any other place and mode decided by the Executive Director. The interview date is not specified in the notice. Candidates have to score the minimum qualifying marks (suitability standard) fixed by the Selection Committee for empanelment in order of merit. Those who do not meet it will not be considered, irrespective of merit position. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview. The procedure is indicative and subject to change at the discretion of the Executive Director.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies in the Department of Nuclear Medicine: 2 for Technologist, 2 for Technical Officer and 2 for Senior Technical Officer, all UR. The vacancies are provisional and subject to variation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The first cut-off date is 11 December 2026, and the Google form submission must reach by 5:00 PM on or before that date. Unfilled vacancies will be notified later with subsequent cut-off dates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Technologist (Nuclear Medicine)?
faq.answer: B.Sc in Nuclear Medicine Technology from a recognized university/institution, or B.Sc in life sciences with a post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine (DMRIT, DNMT or DFIT).

faq.question: Q4. What is required for the Technical Officer and Senior Technical Officer posts?
faq.answer: Technical Officer needs M.Sc Nuclear medicine technology plus 5 years' experience as Nuclear Medicine technologist. Senior Technical Officer needs M.Sc Nuclear Medicine Technology with 60% marks, or M.Sc with 60% plus a PG diploma in Nuclear Medicine with 50% marks, and 02 years' experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is upto 40 years for all three posts, counted as completed age in years on the last date of submission of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Technologist gets Rs. 56,640/- per month, Technical Officer Rs. 89,760/- per month and Senior Technical Officer Rs. 1,08,320/- per month, all consolidated with no enhancement during the contract period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: General/OBC/EWS candidates pay Rs. 1,000/-, which is non-refundable, by NEFT. PwBD/SC/ST candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed form from the AIIMS Nagpur website, pay the fee if applicable, and send the application with the payment receipt and certificate copies through the Google form given in the notice by 5:00 PM on 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on qualification and experience, with a possible screening test if applications are many, then scrutinised and interviewed. They must score the minimum qualifying marks fixed by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely on contract for 11 months, or till regular appointments are made, whichever is earlier, and cannot be regularized at any stage.
